response.justification: Bogdan is an experienced, versatile full-stack and systems engineer with strong software craftsmanship credentials, but his profile does not match a Director-level Principal Engineer role focused on AI strategy. His AI-specific experience is minimal (a few months on MCP tooling in his current role), he lacks demonstrated recognized AI products/platforms, and his career trajectory shows senior IC/staff-level scope rather than director-level strategic influence, customer advising, or cloud/AI thought leadership.
strengths: 15+ years of diverse engineering experience across web, mobile, embedded, and infrastructure systems
Demonstrated entrepreneurial spirit as founder of an open-source geo-data platform (GISCollective)
Strong software craftsmanship background (TDD, CI/CD, testing frameworks) and history of teaching/mentoring via workshops and talks
concerns: Minimal AI/ML depth—only brief, recent exposure to AI-agent tooling (MCP) with no demonstrated AI products or platforms
No evidence of director-level strategic scope, executive customer advising, or cross-org influence expected for this role
No advanced degree or specialized credential in AI, and cloud expertise appears limited to basic AWS CDK usage

key_factors.factor: Long tenure and broad engineering experience
